title: Keessummeessitoota sodaa fide
intro: Magaalaa hammeenyaan nyaate keessatti, hojjetaan amanamaan tokko guyyaa tokko daawwattoota utuu hin eegin argate. Nageenya isaaniif kan yaadda'e namni dhuunfaa kun eegumsa kan kennu yoo ta'u, ummanni magaalattii garuu waan nama qaanessu gaafate. Hojjetaan kun balaa akka dhufu akeekkachiifamee, maatii isaa wajjin dukkana haguugamee baqatee, magaalaa badiisaaf mallatteeffame dhiisee deeme. Amantiin kophaa isaa kun eenyu?
clues: Ummata gocha qaanii irratti bobba’e tokkotti ergamaa ta’ee ergame.
Daawwattoonni hin eegamne gara mana koo kan dhufan siʼa taʼu, kan koo caalaa nageenya isaaniitiif nan yaaddaʼa ture.
Sabni koo akeeka hamaadhaaf keessummoota koo arguuf kan gaafatan siʼa taʼu, anis isaan waliin sababeeffachuu yaale.
Daawwattoonni koo ergamoota ta’anii of mul’isanii maatii koo fudhadhee halkan akkan deemu na ajajan.
Haati manaa koo waamicha miliquuf godhameef dhaggeeffachuu waan hin dandeenyeef badiisa saba kootu isa mudate.
Magaalaan koo rooba dhagaa suphee laayibarii ta’een garagalte, kutaaleen ishee olka’oon gadi aanaa fide.

trial.answer: Gaaffii sabni koo hammeenyaan keessummoota kootti akka dhiyaatu

outcome.answer: Magaalaan koo osoo hin garagalfamin maatii koo waliin fayyeera

arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verse: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." (11:80)
